reviews.rationale: Review landmark, heading, table, math, figure, note, and generated-list reading order with browser accessibility trees and a screen reader.
Traverse navigation, search, links, notes, media controls, and the interactive fixture by keyboard in forward and reverse order.
Inspect computed text, component, hover, focus, diagram, and forced-color presentations beyond the locked palette pairs.
Review every representative page at 200 percent text zoom and 400 percent browser zoom without loss of content or two-dimensional page scrolling.
Confirm navigation and rich-media behavior with the operating-system reduced-motion preference enabled.
Review representative phone, tablet, and desktop widths plus pointer target size and spacing under WCAG 2.5.8 exceptions.
Test representative pages with current screen-reader and browser combinations before making any accessibility claim.
